project_identity.theme_mode: Light theme primary (clean crisp white & warm alabaster base) with high-contrast Deep Mulberry & Saffron Gold accents

scale.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight

brand_primary.name: Deep Royal Mulberry
brand_primary.usage: Brand logo, structural headers, high-importance accents, dark buttons, active badges

brand_secondary.name: Saffron Gold
brand_secondary.usage: Primary action CTA buttons, star ratings, promo banners, highlights, active toggles

brand_accent_green.name: Basil Mint
brand_accent_green.usage: Pure Veg badges, order status 'Delivered/Preparing', discount tag background, free delivery indicators

brand_accent_red.name: Crimson Chili
brand_accent_red.usage: Non-Veg badge dot, destructive actions, offer expiry alert

mobile_bottom_nav.background: bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-amber-900/10 z-50 fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0

header_nav.customer: Sticky header with location pill ('Sasaram, GT Road ▼'), Search bar shortcut, Offers coupon chip, Cart button with dynamic item badge.
header_nav.restaurant_admin: Top bar with restaurant live toggle switch ('Receiving Orders: ON/OFF'), alert notifications, quick menu toggle.
header_nav.super_admin: Global platform health badge ('Sasaram Hub: Active'), 10% commission revenue counter, quick action buttons.

restaurant_cards.style: Clean white card with subtle 1px border (#E5DEC9), rounded-2xl, soft hover shadow, high impact hero image with offer badge overlay ('50% OFF up to ₹100')
restaurant_cards.details: Restaurant name, ratings badge (e.g., 4.5 ★ in Saffron Gold), delivery time (e.g., 25-35 mins), distance in Sasaram (e.g., 1.8 km), cuisines tags (Biryani, North Indian).

food_item_cards.style: Horizontal layout on mobile/desktop. Left text column: Veg/Non-Veg indicator icon, Dish Name, Price (₹), Rating/Votes, Description. Right column: Square rounded food photo with floating shadow, overlay '+ ADD' pill button with quantity step controls (- 1 +).

live_order_timeline.features: Real-time step highlighting with Basil Mint glow, estimated timer countdown (e.g., 22 mins remaining), delivery driver details (Name, Bike No, Call CTA), live mock route map.

admin_dashboard.cards: Cardless or soft-bordered dense cards. Key metric widgets: Today's Orders, Total Revenue, Platform Commission (10%), Active Riders.
admin_dashboard.charts: Recharts / Shadcn charts with custom color tokens (#4A0E2E for primary area chart, #F59E0B for secondary line chart).

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Fudora branding: Deep Mulberry Violet (#4A0E2E) + Saffron Gold (#F59E0B) + Basil Mint (#10B981). Do NOT use Swiggy orange or Zomato red.
Import Google Fonts 'Plus Jakarta Sans' in index.css or index.html and apply it to the body.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes according to the specification.
Implement mobile-first design with bottom navigation bar for mobile devices (< 768px).
Provide demo data tailored for Sasaram, Bihar (e.g. popular Sasaram restaurants: Grand Sasaram Darbar, Sher Shah Suri Food Court, Maurya Biryani, GT Road Bakers).
Implement working state management for Cart, Order Placement, Order Timeline updating, Favourites, and Admin toggles.
